examples.en: Tang Song of the Tang Sect has courted the Power Gang's favor time and again... Offer Tang Song some sweeteners and let him prepare well.
examples.zh: 唐门唐宋屡次三番向权力帮示好……去给唐宋些甜头，让他好好准备。

examples.en: I need someone to help me break through the Tang Sect's Thousand-Arc Myriad-Symbol Formation, so I can be free of Tang Song's pestering.
examples.zh: 我需要一个人帮我闯进唐门的前逻万象阵，这样我才能摆脱唐宋的纠缠。
